svg.text: CT6 Energy Monitor v0.2 (EasyEDA): ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U-N16R8 on board + ZMPT101B module backup
Every part, every pin, every net. In EasyEDA: place each part (LCSC numbers given), then put a Net Label with the EXACT coloured name on each pin. Same name = connected. Green cards = NEW in v0.2.
CT channels, bias and the on-board ZMPT stage are unchanged from v0.1 (CT circuit proven on breadboard). Power nets: use net labels, not power symbols: +5V, +3V3, +3V3A, GND, VB.
What changed from v0.1 (DevKit) → v0.2 (module on board)
• REMOVED: DevKit sockets J3/J4 and the power-only USB-C. • ADDED: U2 ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U-N16R8 (U.FL → external 2.4 GHz IPEX antenna, better from inside a metal DB box).
• ADDED: U3 AMS1117-3.3 regulator (+5V → +3V3), J2 USB-C 16P WITH data (D+ → IO20, D− → IO19, native USB for flashing/logs), U4 USBLC6-2SC6 ESD.
• ADDED: EN reset (R50 10k + C54 1µF + SW1 RESET), BOOT (R51 10k + SW2 on IO0), J7 UART header, module decoupling C52/C53 next to module pin 2. KiCad schematic: hardware/kicad_v02/.
• ADDED: J8 ZMPT101B module header (+5V/OUT/GND) → R52 10k / R53 22k / C55 10nF → V_MOD, and JP2 selects GPIO9 source: 1-2 on-board stage, 2-3 module.
• Unchanged GPIO map: CT1 IO1 · CT2-CT5 IO4-IO7 · CT6 IO8 · Voltage IO9 · Bias monitor IO10 · OLED SDA IO17 / SCL IO18.

Connect by PIN NAME (IO1, IO4 …) as shown on the LCSC/EasyEDA symbol; pin numbers are per the WROOM-1/1U datasheet and match KiCad 10's official ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 symbol. Pin 41 = big bottom GND pad (solder it).
2 · Power: 5 V in (screw terminal or USB-C) → +5V → AMS1117 → +3V3 → FB1 → +3V3A
USB-C now carries data: D+ (A6/B6) → IO20, D− (A7/B7) → IO19 through U4 ESD. CC1/CC2 5.1k → GND (R1/R2).
Put C50 at U3 input and C51 at U3 output. +3V3 feeds the module and J6; FB1 makes the clean analog rail +3V3A.
SOT-223 · LDO 1 A (LCSC C6186), tab = pin 2 = …
3 · Module support: decoupling, EN/RESET, BOOT, UART header, OLED
C52 + C53 as close as possible to module pin 2 (3V3). Flash: hold BOOT, tap RESET, release BOOT (first time only).
J7: connect a USB-UART with TX↔RX crossed if native USB ever fails. 4-pin tactile switches: the two pins on each side are joined.
Tactile switch SMD · tactile SMD (LCSC C318884)
Tactile switch SMD · tactile SMD (LCSC C318884)
4 · Bias VB ≈ 1.50 V (MCP6002 unit A) + op-amp decoupling (unchanged)
U1 = one MCP6002: unit A (pins 1-2-3) bias buffer, unit B (pins 5-6-7) on-board voltage amplifier.
5 · Mains voltage, on-board ZMPT101B ⚠ 230 V (unchanged, except R48 now → V_ONB → JP2)
AC_* nets are LIVE: keep ≥ 6.5 mm from all other copper + slot under T1 between primary and secondary.
JP2 shunt 1-2 = on-board stage (default) · 2-3 = plug-in module (section 6). C42 + D41 protect GPIO9 in both cases.
6 · ZMPT101B plug-in module backup (blue module on J8)
Module VCC = +5V (its LM358 needs 5 V). 10k/22k scales its ≈2.5 V-centred output to ≈1.7 V. Set JP2 to 2-3 to use it.
Mains L/N go ONLY into the module's own screw terminal. Before connecting, check V_MOD with a meter: ≈1.7 V DC, never > 3.3 V.
Pin header 1x03 2.54mm · blue module: VCC / OU…
7 · CT channel (CT1 shown; CT2–CT6 identical, table below) — PROVEN on breadboard
JP1n: shunt 1-2 = mA CT (100A/50mA, 22Ω burden IN, default) · 2-3 = 1 V CT (30A/1V, burden OUT). 24Ω burden also OK (set HA Burden 24).
M3, no copper. A hole inside the mains area needs a plastic screw.
9 · Full net list (check every net in EasyEDA's Design Manager against this)
Totals: 97 parts, 51 nets. Before ordering: ZMPT101B pin grid 10.0 × 12.7 mm · screw-terminal wire entry · 6.5 mm mains creepage + slot · module antenna U.FL reachable · run EasyEDA DRC.
Not yet tested in hardware: v0.2 power/USB/module circuit, on-board ZMPT stage, ZMPT module path. The CT channel circuit IS tested (30A CT 0.33 A / 12.66 A, 100A CT + 24Ω 4.6 A).
